title: Execution Details dialog can never be resized despite being built for it
existing_state: ExecutionDetailsDialog sets Size 980x680, a MinimumSize of 760x520, and anchors its tab control on all four sides (ExecutionDetailsDialog.cs:58-71) — all resize plumbing — but FormBorderStyle is FixedDialog with MaximizeBox=false (ExecutionDetailsDialog.cs:60-62), so none of it can ever engage. Long command text on the Summary tab, wide per-host Context variable values, and Interactive-session transcripts are permanently confined to a 980x680 window with internal scrollbars; the only escape is Save to File and reading the .txt externally.
recommendation: Change FormBorderStyle to Sizable and set MaximizeBox=true in ExecutionDetailsDialog's constructor (ExecutionDetailsDialog.cs:60-62). The MinimumSize and anchor layout already present make this safe; mirror the sibling RunOutputViewerDialog which is already Sizable with MaximizeBox=true (RunOutputViewerDialog.cs:38-39).
user_benefit: Forensic review of long transcripts and wide variable snapshots gets the full monitor instead of a fixed window — a one-line change that removes daily squinting for anyone using execution history.

evidence.note: MinimumSize + four-way anchors prepared for resize, but FixedDialog + MaximizeBox=false prevent it
Sibling history viewer is Sizable with MaximizeBox=true — the intended pattern
